glosses: to desire
желать, мечтать, жаждать, потребовать
bardzo silnie czegoś pragnąć, chcieć

examples.text: Kobieta miała zachwyt w twarzy, musiała tej ozdoby od dawna pożądać

glosses: czuć silny pociąg fizyczny do kogoś; czuć pożądanie
To want; to wish for earnestly.

examples.text: I desire to speak with you.
Neither shall any man desire thy land.
[S]eeing you desire your child to live, / Thanks, but you work against your own desire; […]

glosses: To put a request to (someone); to entreat.

examples.text: And when they founde no cause of deeth in hym, yet desired they Pilate to kyll him.
Mr. Barrett, however, by fawning and flattery, seemed to be able to make not only Mrs. Churchill but everyone else do what he desired.

glosses: To want emotionally or sexually.

examples.text: She has desired him since they first met.

glosses: To express a wish for; to entreat; to request.

examples.text: Then shee said, Did I desire a sonne of my Lord ? did I not say, Doe not deceiue me?
Desire him to go in; trouble him no more.

glosses: To require; to demand; to claim.

examples.text: A doleful case desires a doleful song.

glosses: To miss; to regret.

examples.text: She shall be pleasant while she lives, and desired when she dies.

glosses: The feeling of desiring; an eager longing for something.

examples.text: Too much desire can seriously affect one’s judgement.

He stood...filled with the desire that his son should be like him, and should have sons like him, to people the earth. It is the strongest desire that can come to a man - if it comes to him at all - stronger even than love or the desire for personal immortality.

glosses: Someone or something wished for.

examples.text: It is my desire to speak with you.
You’re my heart’s desire.

It is tempting to speculate about the incentives or compulsions that might explain why anyone would take to the skies in [the] basket [of a balloon]: perhaps out of a desire to escape the gravity of this world or to get a preview of the next; […].

glosses: Strong attraction, particularly romantic or sexual.

examples.text: His desire for her kept him awake at night.

glosses: Motivation.
To desire strongly, so as to satisfy an appetite; to long or yearn for.

examples.text: to crave for peace
to crave after wealth
to crave drugs

glosses: To ask for earnestly; to beg or demand, as from a figure of authority.

examples.text: I humbly crave your indulgence to read this letter until the end.

My deeds upon my head! I crave the law,
The penalty and forfeit of my bond.
I crave your honour's pardon.
Joseph […] went in boldly unto Pilate, and craved the body of Jesus.

glosses: To call for; to require as a course of action.

examples.text: It is the bright day that brings forth the adder and that craves wary walking

glosses: A formal application to a court to make a particular order.
Vouloir posséder un bien ou un avantage qu’on n’a pas.

examples.text: Il y a de certains biens que l’on désire avec emportement et dont l’idée seule nous enlève et nous transporte.
Il désirait cette promotion plus que tout au monde.

glosses: Souhaiter.

examples.text: Ma femme aurait désiré être riche, et voilà que j’étais pauvre, avec mes petits appointements de deux mille francs.
Je désire ta présence à cet événement.
En effet, Dieu ne dit pas « je veux », j'exige, qui est le langage des puissants de la terre, mais « je voudrais », je désire, qui est le langage de l'amour.
Les caballeros désirent du ouisky ?

glosses: Éprouver un désir charnel pour un homme ou une femme, avoir envie de faire l’amour avec cette personne.

examples.text: Je ne sais pas si Jean-Louis Darc séduisit ma mère ou si ce fut elle qui s’en éprit la première, mais je crois que Céline Thiébault désira ce grand gaillard, cette vigueur animale.

glosses: книжн., устар. хотеть пить, испытывать жажду

examples.text: Истомившиеся путники жаждут.

glosses: перен., книжн. страстно хотеть чего-то

examples.text: Жаждать любви.
Жаждать сострадания.
Шайка диверсантов оголтелых // Жаждала страну поработить.

glosses: высок. то же, что хотеть

examples.text: Какой-то господин желает вас видеть.

glosses: в общении высказывать пожелание относительно чьей-то судьбы

examples.text: Он взял мою руку и сказал, что от всего сердца желает мне счастия в жизни.

glosses: volere qualcosa intensamente

examples.text: desiderare l'amicizia di qualcuno

glosses: immaginare fortemente di realizzare qualcosa

examples.text: abbiamo desiderato che foste sempre tutti con noi

glosses: essere proteso con tutto sé stesso verso un obiettivo

examples.text: ora ho compreso: ho desiderato tantissimo quanto sempre vicino a me
